jobs.description:
City of Rowlett, Texas is seeking a Detention Officer to perform booking procedures, log property, fingerprint inmates, and seize contraband. You will monitor inmate care, including meals and basic medical attention, while maintaining order and responding to inquiries from the public and law enforcement.

You must be able to operate locking and security equipment, conduct searches, and complete detailed daily reports.

jobs.title: Detention Facility Officer: Security, Care & Reports
jobs.description:
City of Rowlett, TX is seeking a Detention Officer to perform detention, intake, and release of inmates under supervision in the City detention facility. You will log property, conduct bookings, fingerprint and photograph inmates, and perform related reports and data entry.

Responsibilities include monitoring inmate care, serving meals, providing minor medical attention, and ensuring security with locking and alarm systems.
